item.title: John Schneider on Newsmax: Dolly Parton Knew Her Value
item.description: Actor and singer John Schneider honored the late country icon Dolly Parton on Sunday, calling her a savvy businesswoman and generous philanthropist.

item.title: Dem Brad Lander Learns a Harsh Lesson: No Matter How Far Left, It's Never Enough
Trump Backs Christian-Led Plan to Help Canadian Jews Escape Antisemitism
item.description: Trump endorsed a proposal for expedited legal pathways for Jewish Canadians fleeing antisemitism, as Christian lawmakers urge his administration to act.

item.title: Landlords Say Mamdani Uses 311 System to Pressure Them
item.description: NYC tenant complaints rose 25% this year to over 573,000, with landlords accusing Mayor Zohran Mamdani of using the system to target them.
